notes:
SOURCE/EDITION: 107-page PDF. The cover says "FINAL REPORT / CONFIDENTIAL", but p.3 states it is the "Anonymity-Protected Digital Edition": A.A. members appear as first name + last initial, while nonalcoholic trustees and employees appear with full names. So edition = "anonymity". Every full surname was reduced to its initial: the 7 Class A trustees (Michele G., Leslie B., Christine C., Judith Ann K., Peter L., Nancy M., Al M.) and the non-A.A. employees (Michelle M., Archives director; Bob S., G.S.B. assistant treasurer; Olga M., Compensation secretary; Zenny M., Finance secretary). Middle names and initials (Leslie "Sanders"/"S.", Peter "F.", Al "J.") were dropped. Titles and suffixes were dropped (Sr./Sister, III, PhD, MD, CSA, FACHE, FAAFP, FASAM). The rosters print both "Sister Judith Ann" and "Sister Judith"; both are recorded as Judith Ann K. Only cities are recorded; no addresses, phones or e-mails. Rosters are on PDF pp. 96-105 (printed pp. 95-104). PDF pp. 101-102 and 106 are photo collages with no text.
CONFERENCE: This was the first virtual Conference (Zoom), held May 16-19, 2020. It was originally scheduled for the third week of April in New York and was postponed because of COVID-19. Theme as printed: "2020: A Clear Vision for You" (the cover prints "A Clear Vision for You"). 135 Conference members: 93 delegates, 27 trustees and directors, and 15 G.S.O./Grapevine/La Viña staff.
DELEGATES: All 93 areas were represented by their delegates; no alternates are noted. Panels come from the "(Panel nn)" tags in the Area Delegates list: 48 delegates in Panel 69 and 45 in Panel 70. Area names are title-cased from the printed upper-case headings; Area 15 is printed "...VIRGIN ISLAND/ANTIGUA". Name fixes: (a) Area 36 is printed "Melissa (Missy) R." in the delegate list, but both 2020 committee rosters print "Missy P." and the 2019 report's delegate list prints "Melissa (Missy) P.", so it is recorded as "Melissa (Missy) P.". (b) Area 74 is printed "Charlene (Char) V.D." (roster "Char V.D."). It is recorded as "Charlene (Char) V. D." so the name ends with a last-initial token; the 2021 report prints "Charlene (Char) V.". (c) Area 6 is printed "Teddy B.W." in the rosters and "Teddy B.-W." in the delegate list; the delegate-list form is used.
CONFERENCE COMMITTEES: 11 primary committees plus 2 secondary ones (Archives and International Conventions/Regional Forums, marked with superscript 1). The 93 primary seats give each delegate exactly one primary committee. Every member name uses the Area Delegates list spelling (for example, roster "Bobby D." -> "Robert (Bobby) D." and "J.J. S." -> "Gerald (J.J.) S."). Every committee has exactly one chair (*) and one alternate chair (**). Committee secretaries who are not G.S.O. staff: Finance = Zenny M. (assistant director of finance, non-A.A. employee); Archives = Michelle M. (Archives director); Grapevine = Jon W. (Grapevine senior editor). The ICRF secretary is printed "Julio E., Sandra W." (co-secretaries). No trustees or directors are listed inside the Conference committee rosters.
2021 CHAIRS TABLE: Area numbers were resolved from the area names printed in the table. Jerry S. (Area 8) is printed as alternate chair for both Archives and Grapevine. All chairs and alternates are Panel 70 delegates and members of the same committee in 2020.
TRUSTEES' COMMITTEES: The 13 committees are recorded as printed, with names as printed in that roster (Tom A., James D., Kathi F., Francis G., Ino F.). "*" means Appointed Committee Member: George W., Amalia C., Katie H., Allison C. and Shari M. are recorded as type "appointed". The footnote says Michele G. is an ex officio member of all committees and Greg T. of all except Audit, Compensation and Nominating; neither was added as a member, and Michele G.'s trustee_committees is therefore empty (as in the 2018 and 2021 files). The printed secretary of the trustees' C.P.C./Treatment and Accessibilities Committee is Diana L. only, although the staff report says Irene D. serves as co-secretary. ICRF has two secretaries: Julio E. (International Conventions) and Sandra W. (Regional Forums), stored as "Julio E., Sandra W." (same form as the Conference ICRF committee).
TRUSTEES: 21 trustees (7 Class A, 14 Class B), named as printed in their bios: Thomas L. A., James (Jimmy) D., Kathryn F., Francis H. G., Patricia (Trish) LaN. "Ginger R.B." is recorded as "Ginger R. B." so the name ends with a last-initial token. Rotating trustees (*): Thomas L. A. (West Central), Carole B. (general service trustee) and Cate W. (Western Canada). Rotating nontrustee directors (*): Josh E. (Grapevine; elected general service trustee in May 2020) and Homer M. (A.A.W.S.). Michele G.'s elected_year is 2010: she joined the board after the 60th Conference in April 2010 and became G.S.B. chair after the 67th. Nancy M. was "approved by Conference ... in 2016". The trustee_committees lists are built from the trustees' committee roster and match the bios. Exception: the bios of Leslie B., Cathy B., Ginger R. B. and Homer M. also name a "Retirement Committee", which has no printed roster, so "Retirement" was appended for those four. Homer M.'s bio omits Archives, but the roster lists him on it, and the roster was used. Board roles come from the G.S.B. officers list and the A.A.W.S./Grapevine director lists. past_delegate: the panel is as printed. The area is filled only where the text prints it (Ginger R. B. Area 92; new trustees Mike L. Area 24 and Irma Area 91) and is null otherwise; it was not inferred from residence. Beau B., Josh E. (a former ACM) and Tommi H. are not past delegates.
NEWLY ELECTED: These were elected by the G.S.B. following the 2020 Conference (May 2020). Josh E. (general service trustee). Mike L. (West Central regional trustee; printed "Panel 53 delegate from Area 24" although he lives in Omaha, NE). Irma V. de B-N (Western Canada regional trustee; printed form kept; the 2021 report prints "Irma V."). Cindy F. (AA Grapevine nontrustee director; class null; Panel 61, area not printed). No new Class A trustee or A.A.W.S. director is listed.
STAFF: G.S.O. staff = Greg T. (general manager) plus the 12 staff listed on p.104. Assignments come from the sign-offs on the "Trustees' Committees and Staff Reports" section and from committee secretary roles. There is no "director of Staff Services" in 2020, so staff_director = "". Mary C. is staff coordinator, secretary to Policy/Admissions, G.S.B. assistant secretary and an A.A.W.S. director. The A.A.W.S. director list prints "Gregory T."; Greg T. is the same person. Grapevine staff = Albin Z. (publisher) and Jon W. (senior editor), as in the GRAPEVINE STAFF list. Karina C. (associate La Viña editor) and the Grapevine director of operations appear only among the nonvoting personnel and are not included.
CONFERENCE CHAIR: Ray McC., Area 91 Saskatchewan (Panel 69), signs the Greetings as "Delegate Chair". The name uses the delegate-list form "Raymond (Ray) McC.".
FAREWELLS: farewell_count is null because the virtual 2020 report has no Delegate Farewells section and states no number. 48 Panel 69 delegates rotated off.
VALIDATOR: 0 errors and 0 warnings.
